stills.label: mode.marathon-l2-after-faceoff.jpg

puck.evidence: Not visible; the extreme distance to the far end renders any small disc completely lost at sub-pixel resolution.

carrier.evidence: Cannot be determined because the lone distant figure by the far boards is barely 10 pixels tall and lacks any visible puck or possession cue.

team_colours.evidence: The foreground skater is clearly bright cyan-blue, but the distant orange skater is reduced to an indistinct speck near the red goal frame.

far_net.evidence: Located at center top near the boards, but it appears as a flat red horizontal bar only about 30 pixels wide directly under an 86 m indicator.

zone_strips.evidence: A thin dark-red line spans horizontally across the middle of the frame over alternating blue-tinted concentric ice rings.

stills.first_look: The back of the large blue player number 7 in the foreground
noise: Wide concentric blue-and-white rings on the ice surface resembling curling targets
Large keybind legend strip spanning the lower screen width
Bold blue selection ring around the player's skates

stills.label: mode.marathon-l2-after-farnet.jpg

puck.evidence: Found immediately to the right of the central scrum at the stick blade, highlighted by a bright yellowish glowing spot on the ice.

carrier.evidence: The orange skater facing right has their stick blade contacting the glowing puck and is encircled by a faint concentric target reticle.

team_colours.evidence: Two clear contrasting colours: vibrant sky blue on player 7 and a teammate, versus warm orange on the opposing skaters.

far_net.evidence: Centred directly behind the cluster of skaters, clearly rendered as a red rectangular frame roughly 110 pixels wide with visible white netting.

zone_strips.evidence: Only curved red faceoff circles and goal crease markings are visible; standard transverse blue/red zone divider lines are absent or out of frame.

stills.first_look: The central cluster of orange and blue skaters fighting near the goal
noise: Overlaid text subtitle 'Long carry up the ice.' directly under the foreground skater
Thick blue indicator ring around the controlled skater's base
